name: CaseGridInFlexFill
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-in-flex-fill" (grid-composition). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a grid frame as a FILL child of a flex (auto-layout) parent
